scenarios.purpose: Raw output with unlimited missing health
Twenty players with tank damage and raid pulses
Recovery from a defined damage spike

metrics.rawHealingHps: Sum of healing amounts before overheal divided by full encounter seconds.
metrics.effectiveHealingHps: Attributed health actually restored divided by full encounter seconds.
metrics.overhealFraction: One minus effective healing divided by raw healing; null when raw healing is zero.
metrics.appliedAbsorbHps: Shield amounts applied divided by full encounter seconds, including unused capacity.
metrics.consumedAbsorbHps: Attributed damage actually prevented by shields divided by full encounter seconds.
metrics.effectiveSupportHps: Effective healing plus consumed absorbs divided by full encounter seconds.
metrics.engineHps: Preserve the native value separately; this snapshot adds raw healing and applied shielding.

raidComposition.objective: Maximize raid damage among rosters satisfying configured role, healing, survival and utility constraints.
rules: Derive support from actual roster providers; do not copy the DPS baseline's external buff package.
Respect parties, talents, pets, auras, blessings, totem choices and external cooldown capacity.
Score complete roster simulations instead of summing individually full-buffed DPS.
Validate healing teams together before accepting fewer healers.
Report near-best feasible alternatives and uncertainty; a bounded search does not prove a global optimum.

sourcePolicy.referenceImage: User-supplied healer comparison; original inputs and EHPS definition unknown; numbers are not imported.
